comment: Regression limits for the default chain (alias_suite.py gate). Baselines: round 4 (3164dda2) and round 5 (c940e705), 3840x2160 -> 2560x1600, NVIDIA, sigma-delta 8-bit; limits = baseline + margin (1.5 dB aliasing, 0.05 MTF, 2 points ringing, 1.5 dB pan error). Other pairs get limits after their first full run.
